name: kotlin-user-projects
description: Skills for maintaining Kotlin user-project forks used as Kotlin quality gates: rebasing kotlin-community/dev and wiring custom Kotlin repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain Kotlin user-project forks used to test new Kotlin versions
interface.longDescription: Skills for open-source project forks that check new Kotlin versions on kotlin-community/* branches. Rebase kotlin-community/dev onto the latest main/master, verify the result on TeamCity, and declare the custom Kotlin Maven repository through Gradle exclusiveContent.
defaultPrompt: Rebase kotlin-community/dev onto the latest origin master.
Declare the custom Kotlin repository with exclusiveContent.
